title: Bridging Thought and Action: Taming Long-Horizon Instability in Open-Source LLM Agents with a MetaTool-Enhanced ROS Framework
abstract: arXiv:2609.13335v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled more natural human-robot interaction, but open-source models often exhibit unstable long-horizon reasoning and inefficient action execution when deployed in agentic robotic frameworks. This paper presents an enhanced ROS-Agent based architecture that improves task reliability and execution efficiency for agentic robotic systems using open-source LLMs. The proposed system introduces a novel intermediate mechanism, termed the MetaTool, which enforces structured planning prior to action execution. Given a natural-language command, the MetaTool induces the LLM to generate a pseudo-code plan of intended tool invocations, which is stored in the ROS-Agent's scratchpad and persists throughout execution. By explicitly separating planning from execution, the proposed approach reduces execution loops and improves deterministic behavior. translated_title: 架起思维与行动的桥梁：使用MetaTool增强的ROS框架驯服开源LLM智能体的长时程不稳定性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）已使人机交互变得更加自然，但开源模型在部署于智能体机器人框架时，常常表现出不稳定的长时程推理和低效的动作执行。本文提出了一种增强的基于ROS-Agent的架构，提升了使用开源LLM的智能体机器人系统的任务可靠性和执行效率。该系统引入了一种新颖的中间机制，称为MetaTool，它在动作执行之前强制进行结构化规划。给定一个自然语言指令，MetaTool诱导LLM生成预期工具调用的伪代码计划，该计划存储在ROS-Agent的暂存区中，并在整个执行过程中持续存在。通过显式地将规划与执行分离，所提出的方法减少了执行循环并提高了行为的确定性。该架构在一个定制移动机器人平台上进行了验证。
tldr: 提出了一种MetaTool增强的ROS-Agent框架，通过在动作执行前强制LLM生成伪代码工具调用计划并存入暂存区，显式分离规划与执行，从而减少执行循环并提升开源LLM机器人智能体的任务可靠性与执行效率。
en_tdlr: Proposes a MetaTool-enhanced ROS-Agent framework that enforces structured pseudo-code planning of tool invocations before execution, explicitly separating planning from execution to reduce execution loops and improve task reliability and efficiency of open-source LLM robotic agents.
